factProposals.value: A final test report is generated by npm run test-report from the full test suite, an end-to-end smoke test on a real deployment, and recorded acceptance results.
User acceptance is recorded per scenario on /testing; the report says READY only when every scenario has been run and passed.

decisions.statement: Acceptance needs every scenario run and passing, not just no failures.
decisions.rationale: an untested scenario is not evidence of no critical issues

limitations.statement: User acceptance is not finished: 5 of 14 scenarios are recorded, so the report says NOT READY and the acceptance criterion is not ticked.
Final testing ran against SIMULATED Tyler, Caselle, ArcGIS and Cityworks stand-ins.
